```yaml
name: Release

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*'

permissions:
  contents: write
  packages: write

jobs:
  release:
    name: Release ${{ matrix.target }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            bin: azul
            name: azul-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            use-cross: false
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-musl
            bin: azul
            name: azul-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl
            use-cross: true
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            target: aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
            bin: azul
            name: azul-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
            use-cross: true
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            target: aarch64-unknown-linux-musl
            bin: azul
            name: azul-aarch64-unknown-linux-musl
            use-cross: true
          - os: macos-latest
            target: x86_64-apple-darwin
            bin: azul
            name: azul-x86_64-apple-darwin
            use-cross: false
          - os: macos-latest
            target: aarch64-apple-darwin
            bin: azul
            name: azul-aarch64-apple-darwin
            use-cross: false
          - os: windows-latest
            target: x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
            bin: azul.exe
            name: azul-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
            use-cross: false

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          targets: ${{ matrix.target }}

      - name: Install cross
        if: matrix.use-cross
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@v2
        with:
          tool: cross

      - name: Build binary
        env:
          CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_LTO: true
        run: |
          if [ "${{ matrix.use-cross }}" = "true" ]; then
            cross build --release --target ${{ matrix.target }}
          else
            cargo build --release --target ${{ matrix.target }}
          fi

      - name: Create archive
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cd target/${{ matrix.target }}/release
          if [ "${{ runner.os }}" = "Windows" ]; then
            7z a ../${{ matrix.name }}.zip ${{ matrix.bin }}
          else
            tar czf ../${{ matrix.name }}.tar.gz ${{ matrix.bin }}
          fi

      - name: Upload to GitHub Release
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          file: target/${{ matrix.target }}/release/${{ matrix.name }}.*
          tag: ${{ github.ref }}
          file_glob: true
          overwrite: true
```
